name: Dawarich
description: Your own location history, like Google Timeline.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database with all your location points, uploaded imports and exports in storage/, the watched/ folder for automatic imports, Redis data, secret keys (state/secrets.env) and the first password (admin-password.txt). Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Dawarich web app and API (for the phone apps), published on host as 6175

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address you open Dawarich at, like http://192.168.1.20:6175. Only used for links in emails: Dawarich works from any address. With an https:// address (your own domain behind HTTPS), Dawarich only allows HTTPS.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first account, demo@dawarich.app. Leave it empty and one is made for you; it is in the app logs in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Used only until you change the password in Dawarich.
